trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was the unhealthy release running everywhere. v2.3.0 is the most recent production release that was healthy, so no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Result:** checkout-api now reports healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to create INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the retry returned a single incident, so it was not filed twice. The description records the rollback and says v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it is investigated.

v2.3.1 still needs a root-cause investigation before it ships again.
